verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Fastmail export feature, such as downloading mail, contacts or calendars in mbox, vCard or ICS, and no documented exit or offboarding flow. The open-standard JMAP API with API tokens is a developer building block a user could script an export against, not a first-party export capability. The 'Import your mail' and migration items cover moving data into Fastmail, not out of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
